headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.7
summary: The CurseForge browser finally has real filters: browse by content type, pick categories and game versions like on the site, and see every category listed on each result card.

items.text: A site-style filter panel now lives behind the new Filters button: browse by Addons, Maps, Texture Packs, Scripts or Skins, then pick categories and game versions, applying with View Results.
Several categories or versions can be selected at once; results are merged and de-duplicated locally because the public API only accepts one of each per request.
Every result card lists its full set of categories on its own line.
The Filters button shows how many filters are active, and Clear All resets the panel.
